data.gender_notes: Navdeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Navdeep means 'new light' or 'deep knowledge' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the words 'nav' meaning 'new' and 'deep' meaning 'deep'. This name is associated with wisdom, intelligence, and enlightenment in Hindu mythology. The name Navdeep carries the meaning “New Light, Deep Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Navdeep usually hope their child will grow to embody new light, deep knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
